title: Heavenly Fate Lock-Key
next_chapter_hook: The final clue left by his father pointed to Mo Xiansheng, that mysterious existence who guards the Tianji Record in the form of a fragmented soul—just how many unsolved mysteries does he still conceal?

text.content: The night wind mourned through the ruins, Chen Ji stood alone in the depths of the ancient site, the Tianji Record Fragment in his hand slightly scalding. Ye Qing's departing silhouette still lingered in his vision, and now he had to face a truth heavier than any Demonic Path Saint. The blurry image on the fragment—Chen Nian's position was shifting—一根刺般扎在他心底最柔软处。十年了，妹妹，你究竟在哪里？

He took a deep breath, put away the Tianji Record, and walked deeper into the core of the ruins. According to the clues Mo Xiansheng had unsealed last time, the records about the Heavenly Fate Lock-Key should be here. The stone walls were covered with ancient characters, glowing with eerie light under the blue spiritual radiance. Chen Ji's footsteps echoed through the empty corridor, each step seeming to fall on his own heartbeat. His father's death, his sister's disappearance, the incomplete Tianji Record... all the mysteries seemed destined to be unraveled tonight.

At the corridor's end, a massive stone door stood before his eyes. Carved upon it was a nine-eyed giant eye, the very symbol of the Heavenly Eye. A cold glint flashed in Chen Ji's eyes—this thing truly was everywhere. He circulated his spiritual energy and pressed his palm against the stone door. After a moment, the door slowly opened, a musty smell rushing toward him, and behind it lay an even more profound space.

Stepping into the stone chamber, Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply. Countless runes densely covered the walls around, and on the wall directly facing the entrance, a massive pattern caught the eye—a human figure bound by chains, with a glowing gem inlaid where its heart should be. Below the pattern, four ancient seal characters struck like thunder: Heavenly Fate Lock-Key! Chen Ji felt his mind explode, his entire body frozen in place.

He forced himself to calm down and carefully read the inscriptions on the stone walls. As his gaze swept over each character, Chen Ji's face grew paler and paler, his breathing more and more rapid. The records on the stone wall were painfully clear: the Heavenly Fate Lock-Key was a special physique refined by the Heavenly Will from the blood relatives of Heaven's Favored ones. Its core principle utilized bloodline resonance—the Lock-Key could resonate with the Heaven's Favored one, thereby shaking or reinforcing the fetters of destiny!

Chen Ji's hand trembled slightly. No wonder, no wonder the Tianji Record couldn't clearly foresee any scene involving Chen Nian—it wasn't because the Tianji Record was incomplete, but because Chen Nian herself was the 'interference source' of the Tianji Record! She wasn't unable to be foreseen, but her existence would sever the connection between the foreseer and the power of destiny! This wasn't a flaw; it was a check mechanism deliberately designed by Heaven! Chen Nian's existence was from the beginning the 'insurance' Heaven left for the mortal world.

What chilled Chen Ji even more was the next passage. 'The Lock-Key can serve as a key, or as a lock core. The key-bearer can use the Lock-Key's power to break the fetters of destiny, but must pay with the Heaven's Favored one's life as the price; if Heaven takes the lock, using the Lock-Key as a sacrifice can solidify the fetters for ten thousand generations.' Chen Ji gave a bitter laugh—so that was it, his father didn't fail back then, but he chose to trade his own life for that sliver of opportunity, yet ultimately still fell short.

dialogue.content: Father... so you knew all along.

text.content: In the corner of the stone chamber, a dusty wooden box caught Chen Ji's attention. He walked over and trembling, opened the lid. Neatly arranged inside were several yellowed booklets, and on the cover of the topmost one, familiar handwriting made Chen Ji's eyes instantly moist—the characters were his father's! 'The things your mother left behind, and the information I've collected over the years.' His father's voice seemed to echo across time, Chen Ji gripped his fists, his nails deeply embedded in his palms.

He opened the first booklet, his father's handwriting filling his vision, each stroke revealing urgency and anxiety. 'Jia You Year 32, I stumbled upon a fragment of the Tianji Record, only to realize this object was the chessboard Heaven uses to position the world. Ji'er has an innate keen intellect, actually resonating with the Tianji Record. Yet the masters of the Tianji Record have never ended well, so I worry deeply...' Chen Ji's vision blurred, he blinked hard and continued reading.

'Jia You Year 35, through deep investigation I discovered that the reason the masters of the Tianji Record met bad ends was all due to the deadly backlash set by Heaven. This backlash force is extremely powerful, ordinary methods cannot resolve it. However, the Heavenly Eye also has vulnerabilities—the Heavenly Fate Lock-Key.' Chen Ji's heart raced as he continued turning pages. 'Through extensive exploration, I finally discovered the Lock-Key's secret in an ancient ruin. If we can find the Lock-Key, perhaps we can break the chains!'

Chen Ji flipped violently to the last few pages, his father's handwriting increasingly messy, clearly written in extreme tension. 'Jia You Year 37, Niannian was taken by people from the Holy Sect. I knew this was Heaven's will, but how could a father watch his son walk the path of doom? Tonight I will go to the Holy Sect alone. If I can rescue Niannian, I will use this method to break the chains; if not...' Chen Ji's hand trembled violently, tears sliding down silently.

dialogue.content: Father... you could have told me... why did you bear it all alone...

text.content: On the last page, the paper was already torn, but the handwriting remained clear—that was his father's final ounce of strength. Chen Ji read every word, his entire body as if dropped into an icy abyss. So Father had discovered Mo Xiansheng's existence long ago, so he had known the guardian was sealed within the Tianji Record Fragment all along, so his layout before death had preceded his son's by a full ten years! Chen Ji gave a bitter laugh, the laughter carrying indescribable bitterness and pride.

In the corner of the last page of notes, there was also a line of almost illegible small characters. Chen Ji leaned in to decipher them, his pupils contracting sharply—'Ji'er, if you can read this, go find Mo Xiansheng.' Just such a simple sentence, yet it was like a thunderbolt splitting the fog in Chen Ji's heart. Mo Xiansheng, Father had known of Mo Xiansheng's existence long ago! Then what did Mo Xiansheng mean by 'completing one volume's goal unseals one page of knowledge'?

Chen Ji slumped to the ground, his mind a tangled mess. His father's layout from years ago, Mo Xiansheng's guidance, Ye Qing's prophecy, even the 'coincidence' of how he obtained the Tianji Record... everything seemed connected by an invisible hand. He suddenly remembered what Mo Xiansheng said when he first appeared: 'I am the guardian of the chessboard Chen Xuan left behind.' The chessboard Father left behind—Chen Ji abruptly looked up, scanning the stone chamber—everything here was Father's setup!

choice.prompt: Father's notes revealed a shocking truth, now you face a difficult choice:

choices.description: Father explicitly instructed to find Mo Xiansheng, indicating he knows more key information about breaking the chains.
choices.visible_cost: May miss the best opportunity to rescue Chen Nian
choices.visible_reward: Obtain complete information on how to use the Heavenly Fate Lock-Key to break the chains
choices.risk_hint: Mo Xiansheng's complete trustworthiness remains uncertain
choices.process_label: follow father's wish, find master mo

text.content: Chen Ji closed his father's notes, carefully placing the materials from the wooden box into his chest. He stood up, the grief in his eyes gradually replaced by determination. Father had paved the way with his life, and he would never let Father's sacrifice be in vain. Mo Xiansheng... this guardian hidden within the fragment, just how many secrets does he still hold? Chen Ji took a deep breath, circulated his spiritual energy, and dove his consciousness into the Tianji Record Fragment.

choices.description: Chen Nian's position is changing—this is a rare opportunity. We must strike while the iron is hot and continue tracking.
choices.visible_cost: May trigger the Holy Sect's trap
choices.visible_reward: Directly obtain Chen Nian's latest location intelligence
choices.risk_hint: The Holy Sect may have set bait

text.content: Chen Ji put away his notes but didn't immediately go in search of Mo Xiansheng. Chen Nian's position is changing—this is the most urgent information right now. He unfurled the Tianji Record Fragment, attempting to capture that blurred image once more. Strangely, this time the vision was clearer than before. Chen Nian's aura was indeed moving, and quickly... No, this isn't normal movement—it seems more like being escorted by someone! A cold light flashed in Chen Ji's eyes.

choices.description: Father, Mo Xiansheng, Chen Nian, the Eye of Heavenly Dao... Link all clues together, and we'll definitely find a new breakthrough.
choices.visible_reward: May discover hidden connections between multiple forces
choices.risk_hint: May fall into the trap of overthinking

text.content: Chen Ji forced himself to calm down. He sat cross-legged, arranging all the information in his mind. Father knew of Mo Xiansheng's existence—Mo Xiansheng was the guardian within the Tianji Record Fragment—Chen Nian was a lock-key crafted by Heavenly Dao—the Eye of Heavenly Dao had been scheming... Suddenly, a terrible thought emerged: what if Mo Xiansheng himself was merely a piece on the Eye of Heavenly Dao's chessboard? Chen Ji's eyes snapped open, his spine ran cold. Once this possibility appeared, it refused to leave.

At this moment, a faint glow emanated from the depths of the stone chamber. Chen Ji looked warily toward it, and at the heart of that Heavenly Fate Lock-Key pattern, the gem that had been dim now glimmered faintly. A familiar aura wafted from within—that was Chen Nian's aura! Chen Ji's body trembled. Could his sister sense what was happening here? The gem's glow grew increasingly bright, as if responding to something.

Instinctively, Chen Ji activated the Tianji Record, and the image on the fragment sharpened suddenly—Chen Nian was imprisoned in the center of a massive formation, several black-robed figures murmuring incantations around her. At the formation's edge, a gem identical to the one on the stone wall was being slowly inserted... "No!" Chen Ji growled. That was reinforcement for the shackles! The Eye of Heavenly Dao's people were using Chen Nian as the lock core, eternally sealing the fetters of destiny!

dialogue.content: Dare to touch my sister, and I'll drag you all to doom!

text.content: Vengeful intent blazed in Chen Ji's eyes. He surged to his feet, ready to charge out of the ruins. Yet at that moment, another line of text flickered across the Tianji Record Fragment—Mo Xiansheng's voice: "Calm down. She won't die, at least not now. The shackles aren't complete; she's still useful." Chen Ji's steps faltered, his fists clenched tight. Mo Xiansheng's words splashed over him like cold water, restoring a sliver of reason.

He scrutinized the image on the Tianji Record anew, discovering details he'd overlooked before. Though the formation was mostly complete, the core gem wasn't fully inserted; those black-robed figures' attire didn't match Holy Sect standards—rather, they resembled... direct forces of the Eye of Heavenly Dao. Chen Ji's pupils constricted—so that was it. The Eye of Heavenly Dao wasn't merely exploiting the Tianji Record; it was simultaneously using the Holy Sect, and using Chen Nian as the lock core!

choice.prompt: The situation has become clear, yet the choice grows more urgent:

choices.text: Directly summon allies for a fierce assault
choices.description: Ye Qing possesses demonic path mists that can conceal aura, and Su Qingyao boasts exceptional combat prowess—combined with himself, the three might catch the Eye of Heavenly Dao off guard.
choices.visible_cost: May expose allies' identities, inviting greater troubles
choices.visible_reward: Fastest chance to rescue Chen Nian
choices.risk_hint: The Eye of Heavenly Dao's power runs fathomless

text.content: Chen Ji hesitated no more. He immediately signaled Ye Qing through the Tianji Record Fragment, while preparing to contact Su Qingyao. Three forces converging, storming the formation's core—this was the simplest, most brutal plan, and precisely what he craved at this moment. Yet just as the signal was about to be sent, his finger hovered mid-air. A fierce assault... was it truly viable? The Eye of Heavenly Dao had been scheming for eons—how could it lack contingencies? Chen Ji forced himself to calm down and reconsider.

choices.text: Follow Father's instructions and seek Mo Xiansheng first
choices.description: Father's dying wish clearly pointed to finding Mo Xiansheng, indicating there must be a deeper scheme at play here. Only by uncovering the truth can he truly save Chen Nian.
choices.visible_cost: Chen Nian might encounter misfortune before then.
choices.visible_reward: May obtain the key method to break Heavenly Eye's scheme.
choices.risk_hint: Time is tight, it might be too late.
choices.process_label: obey father, ask master mo first

text.content: Chen Ji withdrew the signal he was about to send and took a deep breath. His father's notes still had wet ink, and that line 'Go find Mo Xiansheng' seemed to be gazing at him across time and space. His father would not harm him, let alone joke at a life-and-death moment. Mo Xiansheng must be holding some crucial information—the perhaps only method to break the shackles. Chen Ji closed his eyes, immersing his consciousness into the Tianji Record Fragment, and murmured: 'Mo Xiansheng, I know you're listening. Father asked me to find you.' Deep within the fragment, a phantom slowly emerged.

choices.text: Proceed on both tracks simultaneously—inquire Mo Xiansheng while tracking the location.
choices.description: Don't place all hope on one path—simultaneously advance two lines as mutual backup.
choices.visible_cost: Energy is scattered, both sides may not be thorough enough.
choices.risk_hint: May be slow on both sides.

text.content: Chen Ji made the decision most fitting to his character—don't put all eggs in one basket. While using the Tianji Record to inquire of Mo Xiansheng, he simultaneously continued tracking Chen Nian's position changes. The Tianji Record's image blurred once more, but this time Chen Ji noticed a detail—there was a terrain outline in the image, strikingly similar to a part of the ruins beneath his feet. Could it be... the place where Chen Nian was imprisoned was another area of these very ruins?

Mo Xiansheng's ethereal form slowly coalesced within the Tianji Record Fragment, his features still blurred, but his voice carried more weight than usual: 'You've seen it.' Chen Ji didn't waste words, directly asking: 'Father's testament clearly pointed to finding you. How long do you plan to hide the truth about the Heavenly Fate Lock Key from me?' Mo Xiansheng paused silently, then said: 'I never intended to hide it from you, only the timing wasn't right.' Chen Ji coldly laughed: 'What timing? Wait until I die outside like my father?'

dialogue.content: 'Your father died from Heavenly Eye's ambush, not from the shackles' backlash. Those are two different concepts, Chen Ji.' Mo Xiansheng's voice was calm, yet carried undeniable authority, 'The shackles will kill every Tianji Record master, but that requires several decades. And your father... he chose to actively accelerate his own death.'

text.content: Chen Ji shuddered violently: 'What do you mean?' Mo Xiansheng's ethereal form sighed softly: 'Your father discovered the method to break the shackles, but that method requires two conditions to be met simultaneously—the Heavenly Fate Lock Key must be present, and must willingly cooperate. To save you, he chose the most extreme approach: using his own death to force the Holy Sect to activate Chen Nian ahead of schedule.' Chen Ji's mind exploded with a thunderclap, tears streaming out. So Father's death was from the very beginning a meticulously designed scheme!

'Your father was a true hero.' Mo Xiansheng's voice rarely carried a hint of respect, 'Knowing his time was running out, he used death as bait, drawing the Holy Sect's attention toward Chen Nian, making Heavenly Eye believe the Lock Key would be activated. Then through secret arts, he entrusted a wisp of his soul within the Tianji Record—that is me.' Chen Ji猛地抬头，死死盯着墨先生的虚影：'你……是父亲的残魂？'

dialogue.content: 'To be precise, I am the final chess piece Chen Xuan left behind.' Mo Xiansheng said slowly, 'I retained part of his memories and wisdom, but I also have my own consciousness and mission. Each page of knowledge from the Tianji Record is a gift of growth I give you, and also the path of growth your father paved for you with his life.'

text.content: Chen Ji fell silent for a long while, digesting this shocking truth. After a良久，他开口，声音沙哑却resolute：'Father paved the road, the road ahead I walk myself. Tell me, the correct method to break the shackles.' Mo Xiansheng's ethereal form slightly smiled: 'This is the spirit Chen Xuan's son should have.' His voice gradually became solemn, 'The method to break the shackles lies within that pattern before you. The Heavenly Fate Lock Key can resonate with the Heavenly Fate holder—that is the key.'

Mo Xiansheng continued: 'Heavenly Eye used Chen Nian as a lock core to reinforce the shackles—this is the stupidest method—it will only make the shackles tighter and tighter. But if you can resonate with Chen Nian in another way, you can operate in reverse, turning the lock core into a key.' Chen Ji's eyes flashed brilliantly: 'Collapse from within?' Mo Xiansheng nodded: 'A worthy student. Chen Nian's Lock Key constitution is a double-edged sword—used correctly it becomes a key, used incorrectly it becomes a lock core. And what determines all this... is you.'

choice.prompt: The truth has been revealed, and the final choice appears before you:

choices.text: Rush immediately to where Chen Nian is located.
choices.description: Time is pressing; must establish resonance with Chen Nian before the shackles are completely formed, collapsing Heavenly Eye's scheme from within.
choices.visible_cost: May face Heavenly Eye's direct obstruction.
choices.visible_reward: Rescue Chen Nian at the fastest speed, completely breaking the shackle plan.
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Eye may be lying in ambush nearby.

text.content: Chen Ji hesitated no more. He tightly gripped the Tianji Record Fragment in his hand, his consciousness resonating with Mo Xiansheng within the fragment. A warm force surged into his body—that was Father's last gift—a secret technique formula on how to resonate with the Heavenly Fate Lock Key. Chen Ji murmured: 'Father, wait for me.' Then he turned and rushed out of the stone chamber, racing toward the location shown in the Tianji Record's image. Outside the ruins, dawn's first light had just broken through the night, and the battle belonging to Chen Ji had just begun.

choices.description: Reckless action might backfire; I must first master the resonance technique with the lock-key to ensure absolute certainty.
choices.visible_cost: Several hours of preparation time are needed.
choices.visible_reward: The success rate of resonance with Chen Nian has greatly increased.
choices.risk_hint: Meanwhile, Chen Nian's situation might deteriorate.

text.content: Chen Ji forced himself to stop. The time his father had bought with his life could not be wasted on impulse. He retreated to the stone chamber, sat cross-legged before the pattern of the Heavenly Fate Lock-Key, and closed his eyes to study the resonance secret method his father left behind. Time trickled away second by second, and Chen Ji's consciousness gradually delved into the core of the Tianji Record. An unprecedented vision unfolded in his mind—that was his father's final arrangement before death, every step precise to the millimeter.

choices.text: Contact Ye Qing and arrange backup plans.
choices.description: The Heavenly Eye's power runs deep and unfathomable; I must make thorough preparations. Let Ye Qing use demonic path mists to conceal our aura, and Su Qingyao will be responsible for rescue coordination—so even if something goes wrong, there's still an escape route.
choices.visible_cost: Need to share some information with allies.
choices.visible_reward: Even if we fail, we can retreat safely, preserving opportunities for the next attempt.
choices.risk_hint: Allies may face retaliation from the Heavenly Eye.

text.content: Chen Ji sent a message through the Tianji Record to Ye Qing, thousands of miles away. Moments later, the demonic path saint's reply was brief yet forceful: "Received. I will provide covert support but will not reveal my identity." Meanwhile, Chen Ji also sent a communication jade slip to Su Qingyao—he didn't disclose too many details, only mentioning that he'd discovered some important clues and might encounter danger. Su Qingyao's reply was equally succinct: "Thirty li outside the Tianqing Sect, come find me if anything happens." The responses from both allies somewhat eased Chen Ji's heart. No matter what, he was no longer fighting alone.

The sky outside the stone chamber had already brightened considerably. Chen Ji walked out of the ruins' core, greeted by the biting mountain wind of early morning. His robes still carried dust and bloodstains, yet his face held an unprecedented calm. His father had paved the way with his life, Mo Xiansheng protected his growth with his remnant soul, and his sister waited for rescue in the Heavenly Eye's cage... All the burdens pressed upon his shoulders alone, but they also made him clearer than ever before.

Chen Ji raised his head to gaze at the horizon, where the clouds churned as if something was watching him. The corner of his mouth lifted slightly, revealing a dangerous smile: "The Heavenly Eye, is it? You've been scheming for tens of millions of years, treating all seers as chess pieces... Unfortunately, you've miscalculated one thing." He tucked the Tianji Record fragment into his chest and turned to walk down the mountain. "I, Chen Ji, never play by the rules."

dialogue.content: Nian Nian, wait for your brother. This time, it's my turn to save you.

text.content: Mountain wind howled past, lifting Chen Ji's robe corners. His figure stretched long in the morning light, like a sharp sword about to be drawn from its sheath. Ahead lay unknown dangers, behind him rested his father's expectations, and at the very last moment before fate's shackles were about to tighten—waste material Chen Ji was about to reveal his true fangs. The fate of the Heavenly Fate Lock-Key, starting from this moment, would be written by himself. And the true meaning behind Mo Xiansheng's words "the time has come" might only be fully revealed when this scroll concludes.
